source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
This companion helps run and play organised Dominatus events, using the latest Chapter Approved Mission Deck alongside the Dominatus deck. It covers:

- Warhammer Dominatus Event Guidance: adapting the Dominatus deck to organised play.
- Warhammer Dominatus Event Mission Sequence: changes to the usual steps for generating a mission and preparing the battlefield.
- Pairings: pairing players fairly.

Use it with the Warhammer Event Companion, which covers using the Chapter Approved Mission Deck at events and recommended layouts.
